documented_facts.statement: NSS 1999-2000,2004-05,2009-10 are repeated household cross sections, two-stage sampled; linked analysis labels are2000,2005,2010. Household and village identities needed for census village linkage are obscured.
documented_facts.evidence: paper p. 2949; appendix C11 printed pp. . 63-65 (PDF pp. 64-66)

documented_facts.statement: The 2000 source IDs are deliberately copied to successor 2001 districts by the historical geography crosswalk. This creates 2400 additional state rows, not repeated household follow-up or evidence of accidental corruption.
documented_facts.evidence: appendix printed p. 65; merge_nss_panel.do1518-1530,1584-1586; oracle household counts

documented_facts.statement: Household tot_p01 is a district total despite retained village-running-variable label. Normalized weights sum to 1e6 per district-wave; original raw WT is dropped. Population-weighted household analysis additionally uses tot_p_dist.

NSS expenditure has 30-day recall, is adjusted to2010 rupees, and E1 removes electricity expenditure per capita. The welfare/income interpretation needs assumptions. This foundation village file lacks the later SHRUG predicted-consumption outcome.
documented_facts.evidence: appendix printed pp. 57-58,65; MASTER M3, M7, M8; village dictionary

documented_facts.statement: Main NSS Tables 3/5/7 select ifs empty; sample_1011 selects Table B9 sensitivity. Local treatment includes Durg and Kawardha with vplan4=10.5.

The village threshold concerns habitation population >= 300; source p_300_D is1 at 300 although its label says>300. Legacy rf_sample_150 contains 414 state rows including 50 flagged population mismatches; final RD uses outcome-specific selection/bandwidths.
documented_facts.evidence: paper eq1; appendix C5; MASTER187-191; dictionary and oracle

documented_facts.statement: Main RD restricts to states with usable maps, whereas district DD is not restricted on this criterion. Chhattisgarh passes the state criterion but has 1923 missing raw-light rows in each of 2001 and 2011. Projected lights use two past and two future years; this is a measure timing fact, not proof of contaminated baseline in the paper.

The foundation census panel selects matches across source files. Habitation linkage uses exact/fuzzy names and population-agreement screening; match rates vary with village size. These facts do not establish the direction or presence of causal bias.

Six stdt_cluster dependence groups in the household extract, not a claim to have rerun the published collapsed estimator. Published table notes group historical district splits and shared DPRs. Archived collapsed code uses clustvar from vdpr4; uncollapsed code explicitly combines dependencies into stdt_cluster. Exact standard-error reproduction needs reconciliation.
